source_tier: trade press (2 sources) tied to QatarEnergy EPCC award
source_notes: QatarEnergy awarded the onshore-LNG EPCC contract for the 16 Mtpa North Field West expansion (two 8 Mtpa trains) to a Technip Energies / CCC / GAC JV on 25 Feb 2026. At 2024 announcement NFW first cargo was targeted for 2030; per the EPCC-award reporting (Natural Gas Intelligence, 27 Feb 2026) QatarEnergy now expects first cargo by end of 2031. GEM LatestPlannedStartYear should move 2030->2031. (OriginalPlannedStartYear 2030 left unchanged as the as-announced figure.)
scope_note: Unit-level (NFW T7-8 only). Does not affect NFE (T1-4) or NFS (T5-6).
